note.zh-CN: 脚手架入口是 create-vue-mini；运行时包是 @vue-mini/core。
note.en: Scaffold with create-vue-mini; the runtime package is @vue-mini/core.

zh-CN.name: Vue Mini
zh-CN.tagline: 基于 Vue 3 的小程序框架
zh-CN.description: Vue Mini 用 Vue 3 的响应式数据和组合式 API 写小程序，兼容原生语法，可以渐进接入。文档在 vuemini.org，源码在 vue-mini/vue-mini。
zh-CN.audience: 想在微信小程序里用 Vue 3 组合式 API，又不想换一套全新写法的团队。
useCases: 用 npm create vue-mini@latest 创建项目
在页面和组件里使用响应式数据，不再手写 setData
与 weapp 工具链并存，而不是替换五层构建职责
capabilities: Vue 3 响应式与组合式 API
与小程序原生语法兼容的渐进接入

faqs.question: Vue Mini 是 weapp 工具链的第六层吗？
faqs.answer: 不是。它是小程序运行时框架，负责页面写法。weapp-vite 仍管构建，weapp-tailwindcss 仍管样式。

faqs.question: 包名为什么是 @vue-mini/core？
faqs.answer: 运行时发布名是 @vue-mini/core。创建项目用 npm create vue-mini@latest。

en.name: Vue Mini
en.tagline: A Vue 3 framework for mini programs
en.description: Vue Mini lets you write mini programs with Vue 3 reactivity and the Composition API, while staying compatible with native syntax for gradual adoption. Docs live at vuemini.org; source is vue-mini/vue-mini.
en.audience: Teams who want Vue 3 Composition API in WeChat mini programs without throwing away native page structure.
useCases: Scaffold a project with npm create vue-mini@latest
Use reactive state in pages and components instead of setData
Keep it beside the weapp toolchain rather than replacing the five build layers
capabilities: Gradual adoption alongside native mini-program syntax

faqs.question: Is Vue Mini a sixth weapp toolchain layer?
faqs.answer: No. It is a mini-program runtime framework for how you write pages. weapp-vite still owns the build; weapp-tailwindcss still owns styles.

faqs.question: Why is the package named @vue-mini/core?
faqs.answer: That is the runtime publish name. Scaffolding uses npm create vue-mini@latest.
